annotations.title: What changed in a vault since a position was entered

description: What changed for a position in a vault since the day it was entered, in six parts: who can move the money (control changes, each with its transaction), exit liquidity (withdrawable at entry and now), collateral and oracles added or removed, the largest depositor, realised yield since entry against the advertised rate, and readings that stopped. Each part dated and null where it was not held. FREE. A reading of the record, not advice.
name: vault_since_entry
